**Subject: Application for Senior Quality & Automation Engineer**

Dear Hiring Team,

I am writing to express my strong interest in the Senior Quality & Automation Engineer position at Cluey Learning. With over 19 years of software testing experience, an ISTQB Foundation certification, and deep expertise spanning end-to-end automation, cloud-native web architectures, and AI-assisted engineering workflows, I am eager to help shape Cluey Learning’s testing strategy and ensure reliable, high-quality digital learning platforms.

Throughout my career at organizations such as Wpay (Woolworths Group) and Avant Mutual, I have combined strategic QA leadership with hands-on framework development. At Wpay, I built full end-to-end automation suites using Playwright, validated complex API Gateways via automated CI/CD pipelines, and utilized languages including TypeScript, JavaScript, and SQL. Additionally, at Avant Mutual, I led QA through a major cloud migration to a modern .NET and React application, establishing cross-functional quality gates, defect triage rhythms, and data integrity validation across the delivery lifecycle.

I also bring a forward-looking approach to testing innovation. As a Google Cloud Generative AI certified engineer, I developed custom GitHub Copilot SKILLs to automate test script creation, identify coverage gaps, and streamline pull request reviews. Combined with my background in embedding automated vulnerability scanning and regression suites into release pipelines, I focus on proactively building quality, security, and resilience into products from day one.

I welcome the opportunity to bring my automation expertise, test leadership, and passion for AI-driven QA to Cluey Learning. I look forward to discussing how my experience aligns with your technology vision.

Sincerely,  

**Anoop Sinkaran**
